senses.gloss:
औशन, औशनस a. (नी, --सी f.)
[उशनस्-अण्] Belonging or peculiar
to Uśanas; originating from
Uśanas, or taught by him.
--सं
1 The law-book of उशनस् (a
treatise on civil polity).
--2
N. of an Upapurāṇa.

--2

औषणं [उषण-अण्]
1 Pungency.
--2 Black pepper.
--Comp.
--शौंडी
dried ginger.

औषध a. (धी f.) [ओषधि-अण्]
Consisting of herbs.
--धं
1 A herb;
herbs taken collectively.
--2 A
medicament, medicinal drug, medicine
in general.
--3 A vessel for herbs.
--4 A mineral.
--5 N. of Viṣṇu.

औषधिः, --धी f.
1 A herb, plant (in
general); Y. 3. 276 v. l.; see ओषधि.
--2 A medicinal herb; अचिंत्यो हि
मणिमंत्रौषधीनां प्रभावः Ratn. 2.
--3 An
herb which emits fire; विरमंति
नज्वलितुमौषधयः Ki. 5. 24 (तृणज्योतींषि
Malli.); cf. Ku. 1. 10.
--4 An
annual or deciduous plant; ˚धीपतिः
N. of Soma, the lord of plants.

औषधिः, --धी f.

औषधीकृ {c8c} U. To reduce to a
medicament.

औषधीय a. Medicinal, consisting
of herbs.

औषरं, --रकं [उषरे भवं अण्, ततः कन्]
1 Rock-salt.
--2 Iron stone.

औषरं, --रकं [उषरे भवं अण्, ततः कन्]
1 Rock-salt.
--2 Iron stone.

औषस a. (सी f.) [उषस्-अण्]
Relating to dawn, early; ˚आतप
[]
Ki. 9. 11.
--सी Day-break, morning.

औषस्य a. Sacred to Uṣas or the
dawn.

औषसिक, औषिक a. (की f.)
1
Walking out at day-break.
--2
Early born or produced at dawn.
